text:
Lina M: Quick idea — launching 'SI Blackbelt SkillPass' as a micro-credential + hands-on lab access. Need ops flow for vouchers + cloud marketplace entitlement. Thoughts?
Akash P: Love it. What's the min viable product here?
Lina M: MV: 3 short modules (serving runtime, private deploy, ops). Passing quizzes -> SkillPass badge + 24h lab voucher (hardware or cloud). Need clear process for voucher issuance, marketplace entitlement mapping, and badging integration with partner portal.
Maria K: We can reuse the voucher pipeline from the last HW pilot but need per-SI quota, automatic revoke after 24h, and audit logs for compliance. @Jules R can infra spin up a self-service lab image?
Jules R: Yes — we can containerize the lab env. Need list of images + GPU profile options. Prefer a self-service redemption API + calendar-based scheduling to avoid manual ops.
Tom R: Also want a tiny eval harness: run sample inference, validate latency <150ms on a representative config, and pass functional tests. That gives a measurable gating criterion for the badge.
Lina M: Good call. Propose voucher format SKP-{SI}-{epoch} stored in vault and a redemption endpoint that returns a signed session token. Example flow: 
```bash
# create voucher
voucherctl create --partner $SI --type lab --hours 24
```
Akash P: Marketplace note — partners expect a SKU/product in the marketplace that maps to the voucher redemption. For most clouds we need a free listing + entitlement webhook so we can push the redemption code to the partner portal.
Maria K: Add a recert path: if the SI trips a regression alert or fails a sampled audit in 90 days, we prompt recert + offer a remediation lab. Keeps badge meaningful.
Jules R: Draft operational checklist: 
- images: r-inference-dev:latest, r-inference-quant:latest
- GPU profiles: 1xA10g, 2xA100
- quota table per-SI (default 3 concurrent labs)
- revoke cronjob (revoke after 24h)
- redemption API: /redeem/v1
I'll open a runbook PR with these details.
partner-ops-bot: voucher pipeline created: pipeline/si-skillpass-v1 queued (id: p-voucher-2024-852).
Lina M: Timeline? Want a small pilot in ~3 weeks with 3 trusted SI partners. Who owns which deliverables?
Akash P: Partnerships: SKU + marketplace listing + partner legal T&Cs + pilot outreach.
Jules R: Eng Infra: images, redemption API, autoscaling rules for lab sandboxes, and revoke.
Tom R: Eng ML: eval harness, test vectors, and pass/fail criteria document.
Maria K: Enablement: curriculum, quizzes, badging assets, and recert policy.
Lina M: Great. Weekly sync Thurs 10:00am PST. I'll create a Trello board and invite owners. :rocket:
Akash P: +1 — I'll draft marketplace copy and sample SKU mapping.
Tom R: Ping me for test vectors and latency targets.
Lina M: Thanks everyone — I'll post the kickoff doc after this thread and tag the pilot SIs. :tada:
